subject.title: Unpack a packed hold to Not shipped

question: Should Bobby approve merging the v8 persisted reservation-status rename together with `stock.unpack`?
rationale: The repository requires Bobby’s explicit approval for merge, and the status rename is a compatibility-sensitive persisted-data migration.

options.title: Approve the bounded migration
options.body: Approve the PR as the chartered v8 upgrade after confirming the committed local SQLite and persisted Durable Object proof represents the intended compatibility boundary.

options.title: Pause for consumer audit
options.body: Hold merge until any external reservation-status consumers are identified and confirmed to accept `not_shipped` after upgrade.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded migration
recommendation.body: Approve the PR as the chartered v8 upgrade after confirming the committed local SQLite and persisted Durable Object proof represents the intended compatibility boundary.
